actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. EDIT IMAGE 1 into one original walking animation frame of this same girl. Image1 is a standing EDIT TARGET: maintain camera yaw and scale, exact girl identity, hair, clothes, long bamboo bow and right shoulder quiver, change ONLY the leg/arm walking pose. Image2 original portrait is identity reference, Image3 PRIMARY STYLE reference: clean bright rounded painted Daoist Q game art. Native at least 1024x1024 square, transparent RGBA. Entire body/bow in frame, no shadows/text/extra objects. Two arms/two legs. Anatomical LEFT hand holds bow, right arm free. Do not leave neutral standing legs; make new articulated pose: EAST exact side profile facing screen RIGHT. Near RIGHT thigh is closest viewer and begins at SCREEN LEFT under shorts: bend this hip FORWARD strongly so this thigh runs diagonally DOWN-RIGHT across foreground toward screen RIGHT ahead of torso; its shin straightens and heel touches down at screen RIGHT. Far LEFT thigh starts behind near thigh, angled BACKWARD to screen LEFT with rear foot toe touching down, heel raised. The NEAR thigh occludes FAR thigh where crossing. FRONT near knee must be clearly in front of far knee. Right free arm behind. Draw a clear scissor-leg reversed walking contact; not wide frontal stance.
